items.title: Airbnb to Require Temporary Phone Numbers for Large Hosts and Guests
items.summary: Airbnb says the temporary phone numbers are meant to protect privacy. But the change also makes it harder for property managers to turn Airbnb guests into direct bookers.

items.title: A New CTO, a Nasdaq Move and AI Agents: Hilton Makes Its Tech Pitch
items.summary: Hilton wants to be valued like a technology platform. Owners will judge it by whether lower distribution costs actually reach them.

items.title: Philippine Travel Tax Repeal Risks Tourism Funding Gap
items.summary: Scrapping the Philippines’ travel tax would make overseas trips cheaper but strip its tourism infrastructure agency of its main revenue source, with no replacement in the proposed 2027 budget.

items.title: JetBlue CEO Reaffirms Profit Targets, Says Distressed Bonds Reflect a ‘Significant Disconnect’
items.summary: JetBlue shares bounced back after its third-quarter earnings calmed investor fears over a possible Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

items.title: Best Western’s Parent Changes Its Name Again: From BWH to WorldHotels
items.summary: The parent company of the Best Western family of hotels has decided to rename itself WorldHotels to appeal to a broader range of travelers. Its toughest audience may be its own members.

items.title: Royal Caribbean Says Sandals Deal Can Help It Win Half of Guests’ Travel Spend

items.title: Travel’s New Creator Economy: Why Brands Need Smarter Systems
items.summary: Travel brands are pouring more money into creators, but spend alone won’t build an edge. The advantage will come from learning faster, measuring better, and turning what works into a repeatable system.

items.title: Lanserhof’s Medical Resorts Look Beyond Weight Loss and Longevity Fads
items.summary: Lanserhof's sharpest longevity pitch is restraint: knowing what a guest needs, and what they don't. A €95 million investment and plans beyond Europe will test whether the business can keep the medical judgment and personal attention behind that promise.
